note: Edgefield County (SC) zoning districts are shown only in the qPublic/Schneider web viewer (separate Edgefield, Johnston and Trenton zoning layers), which is behind Cloudflare and offers no REST endpoint; county zoning documents are PDFs. The county's GIS services (Clemson Edgefield_Features FeatureServer) hold wetlands, sinks, PRT and county boundary only. No public queryable zoning polygon service was found after searching ArcGIS Online/Hub, county and town sites.
